finding: Main found that the run-ledger check used in checkpoint navigation receipts counted rendered cells per row and reported all_rows_four_cells=true. GitHub-flavored table rendering silently drops cells beyond the header count, so a row with unescaped pipes inside its statement still rendered four cells while losing its disposition-link cell. Three rows had this defect: the info-4 w8 common-middle row (added about 19:02 PDT) and the two info-6 rows added at 20:31 and 20:34 PDT. In each, the disposition link did not render.
classification: Parent DOCUMENTARY MINOR in navigation verification. No ledger statement, disposition file, adoption scope or mathematical content changed or was lost; the disposition files existed throughout. The affected receipts are not rewritten. Their local-href counts were correct for what rendered, but their all_rows_four_cells result did not establish that every row's disposition link was rendered.
repair: At about 20:35 PDT the three rows were rewritten with escaped pipes (\|), the convention already used elsewhere in the ledger, with identical wording. A stronger check now requires exactly five unescaped pipes per raw row, four rendered cells and a rendered link in every disposition cell. Result at this observation: {"raw_rows":67,"rendered_rows":67,"data_rows":66,"issues":[]}.
limits: Metadata/navigation record only; no scientific claim. All STOP/HOLD/ZERO controls persist.
